questions.question: Which of the following features is typically associated with the cult of sacrifice in monotheistic religions?
choices: A: Performing rituals without a defined location
B: Rejecting ritual practices and symbols
C: Offering sacrifices to a single god
D: Worshiping multiple gods in one temple
questions.explanation: In monotheistic religions, the cult of sacrifice is often associated with the offering of sacrifices to a single god, which is a central practice. This is addressed in various sacred texts and traditions and plays an important role in the religious life of believers.

Which measure is most suitable for protecting against earthquakes?

questions.question: Earthquake-resistant construction significantly reduces the risk of building damage and injuries during an earthquake. In contrast, the other measures are designed for various natural disasters and are not relevant for earthquakes.
choices: B: Flood protection systems
C: Tsunami warning system
D: Earthquake-resistant construction
Which significant invention was developed in China during the Song Dynasty in the 11th century, revolutionizing knowledge transfer and communication?

questions.question: Paper money was introduced during the Song Dynasty and was one of the first forms of money based on paper. This invention greatly facilitated trade and the exchange of knowledge in East Asia and had an impact on trade in other parts of the world.
choices: B: Paper money
C: Gunpowder
D: Printing press
Which artist is known for his developments in perspective representation during the early Renaissance?

questions.question: Filippo Brunelleschi is considered one of the founders of linear perspective, which was crucial for the painting of the early Renaissance. His discoveries enabled more realistic representations of space and depth in the art of that time.
choices: B: Pablo Picasso
C: Vincent van Gogh
D: Filippo Brunelleschi
Which of the following behaviors is typically associated with the courtship of birds?

questions.question: Courtship in birds often involves conspicuous singing to attract a mate. This singing is part of reproductive behavior and helps identify the species as well as deter rivals.
choices: B: Hibernation
C: Foraging
D: Nest building
What do the five rings of the Olympic Games symbolize?

questions.question: The five rings represent the five continents: Africa, America, Asia, Europe, and Oceania. They symbolize the universal unity and peace that the Olympic Games aim to promote.
choices: B: The medal standings of the last games
C: The number of Olympic Games
D: The different sports
